derivation: from H2691 (חָצֵר) and H8484 (תִּיכוֹן) with the article interposed; village of the middle;

occurrences.text: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazar–hatticon, which is by the coast of Hauran.
